purpose: Public source media for ClipForge quality evaluation; labels and model comparison results are separate.

assets.title: Content Translation Screencast (English)
assets.creator: Pau Giner
assets.observedContent: Narrated Wikipedia translation screen recording with no visible speaker.
assets.evaluationUse: Preserve UI text; avoid invented face tracks; align narration with demonstrated actions.

assets.title: James Webb Space Telescope — Eric Smith fixed-camera interview with slates
assets.creator: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center; Eric Smith
assets.license: NASA public-use media; retain NASA/GSFC credit and check item-specific credits before redistribution
assets.observedContent: Single speaker filmed with a stationary camera; black question/title slates interrupt the interview.
assets.evaluationUse: Speaker reacquisition after slates; silence handling; consistent single-person framing.

assets.title: AMI manual annotations v1.6.2
assets.creator: AMI Consortium
assets.license: CC BY 4.0 (signals and transcription; see archive for other annotation terms)
assets.note: Ancillary archive only. Matching AMI videos are unavailable locally; these are not labels for the nine downloaded videos.

assets.title: Extreme weather with Hannah Cloke
assets.creator: The Royal Society; Roma Agrawal and Hannah Cloke
assets.observedContent: Studio science interview alternating two-shots and close-ups.
assets.evaluationUse: Complete explanations, clean hooks, speaker continuity across camera cuts.

assets.title: What Great Apes can tell us about language
assets.creator: The Royal Society; Roma Agrawal and Gilly Forrester
assets.observedContent: Studio interview including a handheld puzzle-board demonstration.
assets.evaluationUse: Keep meaningful props visible; preserve explanation and payoff; distinguish listener from speaker.

assets.title: Automation and Empathy: Can We Finally Replace All Artistic Performers with Machines?
assets.creator: Moritz Simon Geist; CCC VOC recording
assets.observedContent: Stage presentation with slides, a small presenter inset and visual demonstrations.
assets.evaluationUse: Layout selection, small faces, slides and demonstrations that must remain intelligible.

assets.title: Blender Tutorial. A cup of tea.
assets.creator: Fun with Open Source
assets.observedContent: Blender modelling screen recording with no audio track.
assets.evaluationUse: Intentional negative control: no hallucinated speech or speakers; visual-only content handling.

assets.title: Tears of Steel
assets.creator: Blender Foundation / Mango Open Movie Project
assets.observedContent: Cinematic dialogue, action, effects, music, rapid cuts and a credits tail.
assets.evaluationUse: Shot boundaries, non-speech audio, dialogue context, credits exclusion and cinematic reframing.

assets.title: Interview with Steve Wozniak
assets.creator: ConversationEDU / The Conversation
assets.observedContent: Two-person sofa interview alternating a fixed two-shot and close-ups.
assets.evaluationUse: Speaker changes, off-screen interviewer, listener gestures and conversational clip boundaries.

assets.title: Shipping Godot: From Build to Player
assets.creator: Ben Vehling, Paul Lawitzki, Pablo Navarro, Dom Harris, Joseph Hill; GodotFest / CCC VOC recording
assets.observedContent: Fixed wide view of five seated panelists, with audience silhouettes in the foreground.
assets.evaluationUse: Active speaker selection among visible listeners; stable framing; long-form highlight selection.
